notes.title: Patch 1.0
notes.content:
1. Added mouse invert-Y option
2. Clarified game instructions (in the form of an opening message from Prof Xenoba) that all players should read
3. Range of player walking speeds has been increased (but we still recommend taking it slowly, you know, to smell the roses)
4. Fixed problem with leaving the PlantGen station
